subject.title: feat: native human-format rendering for gh read commands

question: Should supported non-TTY human-format reads switch by default from real `gh` output to Octopool’s documented approximate renderer, or should native rendering require explicit opt-in?
rationale: This is an intentional user-visible compatibility change rather than a mechanical defect: the branch replaces an existing delegation path and documents several output divergences.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep real `gh` delegation as the compatibility default and expose native human rendering through a clearly documented opt-in surface.

options.title: Approve the default replacement
options.body: Accept the output-contract change for quota savings, with live compatibility proof for representative supported commands and clear upgrade communication.

options.title: Retain delegation
options.body: Keep the existing non-TTY delegation behavior if maintainers do not want another human-output contract to support.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep real `gh` delegation as the compatibility default and expose native human rendering through a clearly documented opt-in surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history makes this contributor the only evidenced routing candidate for the affected command surface.
